Name: (AT) Kitschy Beach Bedroom Furniture
Author: 660px
Description:
[b]edit 2.9.26: added more furniture, along with some variants/slight edits. Thank you for all the kind comments!![/b]

Well, pretty much what it says on the tin...

This is my first time modding (anything) and first time doing pixel art. (  ❛ ֊ ❛)

I just wanted some beachy furniture for my ginger island house. I might add more if I feel so inclined. Thanks for looking!
